response.overview: *Ánimecheri* is a documentary that chronicles how the inhabitants of the Purépecha indigenous community on Janitzio Island—located in the Mexican state of Michoacán—experience and observe the *Noche de Muertos* (Night of the Dead) festival. Community members share details about the preparations, the cooking, the rituals, and the reunion with their deceased loved ones. The island is the primary site for the observance of this tradition, which takes place every year between November 1st and 2nd.
response.title: Ánimecheri
